Concrete steps (time limits, structure, transparent count) plus future reforms: ballot-type voting, spending-threshold protocols, partnerships.

summary: Thorough compliant response: detailed neutral chairing, equal-vote respect for mobilised club members, balanced process, and future ballot-type reform; only flaw is an unsupported budget figure.
